tagline: Leading global producer of iron ore and base metals
hero_kpi_rationale: The Base Metals segment is Vale's primary growth driver with a 25.1% increase in 2025, driven by copper and nickel, despite iron ore volatility. It is the most strategic segment for diversification and future value.

kpis.name: Base Metals Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of copper, nickel, and other metals.
kpis.description: The Base Metals segment recorded significant growth in 2025, driven by higher copper volumes and prices, as well as the resumption of operations in Canada.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by copper (+33.8%) and nickel (+17%)

kpis.name: Iron Ore Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the sale of iron ore, pellets, and logistics services.
kpis.description: The iron ore segment remains the core business but declined in 2025 due to lower fines and pellet prices, despite higher sales volumes.
kpis.signal: Decline despite volume growth, due to price drop

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, a key operational performance metric.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA increased in 2025, supported by strong Base Metals segment performance (+130.9%) which offset iron ore declines.
kpis.signal: Growth despite iron ore weakness, driven by copper and nickel

kpis.name: R&D Expenses
kpis.explanation: Annual expenditures dedicated to research and development.
kpis.description: R&D expenses decreased in 2025, linked to the slowdown in exploration and engineering projects in base metals.
kpis.signal: Sharp reduction in 2025, particularly in nickel

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income declined in 2025 due to an operating loss of $4.6 billion related to nickel impairment in Canada.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline due to nickel asset impairments in Canada

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets to maintain or expand production capacity.

kpis.name: Copper Revenue
kpis.description: Copper revenue increased significantly in 2025, benefiting from higher prices (+10.8%) and sales volumes (+11.6%).
kpis.signal: Major increase driven by volumes and prices

kpis.name: Nickel Revenue
kpis.description: Nickel revenue grew in 2025, supported by higher volumes from the Voisey's Bay project, despite a drop in prices (-8.9%).
kpis.signal: Growth despite lower prices, driven by volumes

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents. Vale does not position AI as a strategic lever in its operational or commercial activities.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or advanced automation tools
Absence of KPIs or initiatives related to digitalization or technological innovation
Exclusive focus on traditional operational metrics such as volumes, prices, and costs
